items.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025
items.q: Like I did the “Ram” album for instance with McCartney.

ctx.x: Can you give me a specific example of maybe like a session with Ringo or McCartney?

Well I’ll tell you – we had a session with McCartney. Like I did the “Ram” album for instance with McCartney. McCartney was terrific but he would come in, no music, no chord changes, he wanted you to learn the song like a band. That’s what he was used to. So he would play the song and you would just sit there and learn the song like a garage band. And he would do multiple takes, and he worked with the drum sound. He was very exacting and a very good producer, Paul McCartney. And probably one of the greatest…
And you’d come back the next day and you’re expected to remember everything that happened before?
